A tiger’s walk through the forest is more than a striking sight it is a glimpse into how it moves through its habitat.  
  
With powerful limbs, padded paws and a flexible body, the tiger is built to move efficiently across different terrains. Its movement may take it through dense vegetation, grasslands, rocky ground and watercourses as it travels across its home range.  
  
Every step is part of life in the wild quiet, deliberate and purposeful.
